kidscade_hoodie_blue.label: 파란 후드티
kidscade_hoodie_blue.rigging: shirt skin weights + rigid upper-spine detail pieces

kidscade_male_body.label: 남자 기본 바디
kidscade_male_body.shaping: upper torso widened smoothly (+14.5% at torso core), thighs slimmed 11.5% and calves 8.5% about each leg axis; native rig and skin weights preserved

kidscade_male_eyes.label: 남자 기본 눈
kidscade_male_eyes.shaping: Uses the unmodified source eyes geometry, UVs and skin weights to align with the native painted face outlines, lashes and eyebrows on character_low

kidscade_male_tshirt.label: 남자 기본 티셔츠
kidscade_male_tshirt.shaping: shirt width increased to follow widened chest and existing animated sleeve clearance; original shirt skin weights preserved

kidscade_male_shorts.label: 남자 기본 반바지
kidscade_male_shorts.shaping: original ninjasuitshort mesh with 7.2% smooth leg opening trim about each leg center, hip/waist retained

kidscade_male_set_policy.label: 남자 기본 세트 메시 정책
kidscade_male_set_policy.rule: reuse existing Chibi mesh topology and source skin weights; no procedural hair, sleeves, or compressed long-pants shortcuts
kidscade_male_set_policy.faceRule: The body already paints eye whites and eyelid lines. Use unmodified source eyes alignment and only the 24 original eyebrow triangles; never draw a second set of lashes.

walkAnimation.preserved: all 11 source animations and clip names; stride, knees, ankle/foot-contact tracks unchanged; upper-arm pitch/roll retuned relative to the original bind pose
walkAnimation.exportBehavior: derived WALK and RUN replace their source counterparts in export when the male body is visible; all public names and the 11-clip count remain unchanged

runAnimation.preserved: original stride, knee and foot-contact timing

kidscade_male_hair_short.label: 남자 짧은 머리
kidscade_male_hair_short.rigging: source hairone topology, UVs, materials and skin weights
kidscade_male_hair_short.shaping: lower source-bob silhouette compressed with smoothstep taper to avoid cutoff creases; eye-level frontal/temple triangles culled below source eyes upper bound +0.02, rear hair kept
kidscade_male_hair_short.geometryPolicy: source rig/UV/weights retained, filtered index faces only

kidscade_male_brows.label: 남자 기본 눈썹
kidscade_male_brows.rigging: original 78-bone skin weights and UVs; only the two connected source eyebrow islands (24 triangles)
kidscade_male_brows.shaping: source left and right eyebrows only; all 180 lash/eye-corner triangles excluded
